BSW Parameter
BSW Type
FrSMCheckWakeupReason
ECUC-BOOLEAN-PARAM-DEF
BSW Description
If FrSMCheckWakeupReason is true, the FrSM will check the wakeup reason in order to skip the wakeup in case of wakeup
by bus. If FrSMCheckWakeupReason is false, the FrSM will always try to perform a wakeup.
